item.title: ADA Space Rolls Out Five Satellites for Batch 03 of Its Star-Compute Space Computing Program
item.description: ADA Space has rolled out five in-house computing satellites for batch 03 of Star-Compute, its planned 2,800-satellite network. They will join 20 already in orbit after launch.

item.title: HUST-Led Team Cuts Contact Resistance 94% in Monolayer WSe2 p-Type Transistors With Oxygen Doping
item.description: A HUST-led team used oxygen doping to cut contact resistance 94% in monolayer WSe2 p-type transistors. A 16nm-channel device reached 1,635 μA/μm with an 81% ballistic ratio.

item.title: Zhejiang University's SpaceCast-Bench: Best VLM Scores 58% at Predicting Spatial Change, Humans 87%
item.description: Zhejiang University's SpaceCast-Bench tests whether VLMs can predict spatial relations after a scene changes. The best of 21 models scored 58.0% against 87.2% for humans.

item.title: Huawei Unveils G1, Its First Continuous Glucose Monitor, After Class III Approval in China
item.description: Huawei has announced G1, its first continuous glucose monitor, after China's NMPA granted it Class III approval. It pairs with phones and watches and is registered for up to 16 days of wear.

item.title: CXMT Moves DDR5 to 32Gb Dies and Lists MRDIMM Server Memory at Up to 12,800Mbps
item.description: CXMT has moved DDR5 to 32Gb dies, with RDIMMs up to 128GB at 8,000Mbps and MRDIMMs up to 192GB at 12,800Mbps. It says servers now account for over half of memory demand.
